title: Proximity-verification policy
description: How close the two parties must be for a hand-off to count, chosen when the agreement is signed. Four ranges, from loosest to closest: the same Wi-Fi network, Bluetooth range, ultra-wideband ranging, or an NFC tap. A hand-off is witnessed in one of the ranges the order allows.

fields.name: bands
fields.label: Detection bands
fields.description: Which ranges count as being there, loosest to closest. Same Wi-Fi network: both phones on one network. Bluetooth: within a few metres. Ultra-wideband: within centimetres. NFC: the phones touch. Pick the ones you can meet with the phone you carry.

1.name: band
1.label: Detected band
1.description: The band the hand-off was witnessed within. Must be one of the committed bands — checked at read time, like every content/policy comparison.

1.name: evidenceUri
1.label: Witness evidence
1.description: Optional reference to the detection artifact at mechanism grain — a device-captured evidence document (geohash cell, keccak-hashed tag/device identifiers, raw-capture hash) or a counterparty co-signature. Raw identifiers (Wi-Fi BSSIDs, BLE beacon ids, NFC tap payloads) and coordinates stay device-held for dispute-time revelation, bound by the raw-capture hash — never pinned publicly.
